evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, upload_files still builds the runner archive with `git archive ... HEAD` and records the source as `git-archive:HEAD`, with no verified-commit parameter or pre-upload recheck. Because the source_commit check happens before VM fetch/boot, a checkout or commit in that window can produce an archive whose bytes do not correspond to the report's source_commit. The digest checks compare only the uploaded copy with the local archive, so they cannot detect this mismatch. This is a real TOCTOU/provenance defect in the intended behavior.
